args: dnf install -y --allowerasing bash ca-certificates curl file zip tar gzip git gcc glibc-devel golang && dnf clean all
apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates git

set -e
  setup-github-token
  git init /src/docker-next
  cd /src/docker-next
  git remote add origin "${DOCKER_NEXT_REPO}"
  git fetch --depth 1 origin "${DOCKER_NEXT_VERSION}"
  git checkout FETCH_HEAD
  rm -f "$HOME/.gitconfig"
git init /src/erofs-utils     && cd /src/erofs-utils     && git remote add origin "${EROFS_UTILS_REPO}"     && git fetch --depth 1 origin "${EROFS_UTILS_VERSION}"     && git checkout FETCH_HEAD

set -e
  setup-github-token
  git init /src/sailor
  cd /src/sailor
  git remote add origin "${SAILOR_REPO}"
  git fetch --depth 1 origin "${SAILOR_VERSION}"
  git checkout FETCH_HEAD
  rm -f "$HOME/.gitconfig"
apk add --no-cache   clang   file   git   openssh-client   openssl   rsync

set -ex

  export SANDBOXD_PKG=github.com/docker/sandboxes/sandboxd

  versionfile -version "${VERSION}" -revision "${REVISION}" -output /tmp/sbx-version.json
  echo -n "${VERSION}" > /tmp/.version
  echo -n "${REVISION}" > /tmp/.revision
  echo -n "${COMMIT_DATE}" > /tmp/.commit_date
  echo -n "${RELEASE}" > /tmp/.release
  echo -n "${DOCKER_NEXT_VERSION}" > /tmp/.docker_next_version
  echo -n "${DOCKER_NEXT_COMMIT}" > /tmp/.docker_next_commit
  echo -n "${NERDBOX_VERSION}" > /tmp/.nerdbox_version
  echo -n "${SAILOR_COMMIT}" > /tmp/.sailor_commit

  echo "-X ${SANDBOXD_PKG}/version.Version=${VERSION} -X ${SANDBOXD_PKG}/version.Revision=sbx-revision-v1:${REVISION}:sbx-revision-end -X ${SANDBOXD_PKG}/version.Package=${SANDBOXD_PKG} -X ${SANDBOXD_PKG}/version.BuildDate=${COMMIT_DATE} -X ${SANDBOXD_PKG}/version.Release=${RELEASE}" > /tmp/.ldflags-cli

set -e
  xx-apk add --no-cache \
    gcc \
    musl-dev
  cd ./cli-plugin
  LDFLAGS="$(cat /tmp/.ldflags) -s -w"
  case "$(xx-info os)" in
    linux)
      LDFLAGS="${LDFLAGS} -linkmode=external -extldflags=-static"
      ;;
  esac
  LDFLAGS="${LDFLAGS} -X github.com/docker/sandboxes/sandboxd/version.BuildTags=${BUILDTAGS}"
  xx-go build -trimpath -tags "${BUILDTAGS}" \
    -ldflags "${LDFLAGS}" \
    -o /usr/local/bin/sbx ./cmd/sandboxes
  ../scripts/verify-release-build-tags.sh "${RELEASE}" "${BUILDTAGS}" /usr/local/bin/sbx "${LDFLAGS}"
  versionfile -check /tmp/sbx-version.json -binary /usr/local/bin/sbx
  xx-verify --static /usr/local/bin/sbx

set -e
  export LLMMAN_REPO="${LLMMAN_REPO}"
  export LLMMAN_VERSION="${LLMMAN_VERSION}"
  export LLMMAN_OS="${TARGETOS}"
  export LLMMAN_ARCH="${TARGETARCH}"
  export LLMMAN_DEST_DIR=/out
  # Higher authenticated rate limit than anonymous requests get.
  export GITHUB_TOKEN=$(cat /run/secrets/GITHUB_TOKEN)
  bash /scripts/download-llmman.sh

set -e
  setup-github-token
  OUTDIR=/out BUILDDIR=/build pkg-static-build
  rm -f "$HOME/.gitconfig"
